scripts.install:backend: python3 -m venv backend/.venv && backend/.venv/bin/pip install --upgrade pip && backend/.venv/bin/pip install -r backend/requirements.txt
scripts.dev: npm run install:backend && npm run install:frontend && npx concurrently -n backend,frontend -c cyan,magenta "cd backend && .venv/bin/uvicorn main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 --reload" "npm --prefix frontend run dev -- --host 0.0.0.0"
